input.text: The 404 fallback reason never names the ceiling, so no eval can check that a fallback stays under it. Fix it in the router (safer) or relax the golden (faster)?

turns.label: Reporting
turns.text: Reproduced with pnpm eval --only router-fallback-404: route_reason_contains "ceiling" fails because the router's 404 reason never says "ceiling". You chose to fix the golden: change the assertion in evals/demo/router-fallback-404.json to "fell back to". One line; the router stays as it is, and the eval no longer checks the ceiling.
